title: US black psychokinesis unit separate from remote viewing programs

tellings.quote: evidence, you know, based on the testimony of some of our top remote viewers that there was a black unit in the United States that was doing these things in the 1970s and 80s. It was separate from the remote viewing programs that were eventually defunded by Congress.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani says on Jesse Michels' podcast that, based on what some of the country's top remote viewers have said (people trained by the government to describe distant places using only the mind), the US had a secret unit in the 1970s and 80s working on psychokinesis, the idea of moving or affecting things with the mind. He says this unit was separate from the remote viewing programmes that Congress eventually stopped funding. If true, it would mean the government took mind-over-matter powers seriously enough to study them in secret.
